title: Math is Easy
story: Your friend asks you to split a pizza bill. The pizza costs $24 and there are 4 of you. Instead of doing math in your head, wouldn't it be great to have a helper that calculates anything instantly?
why: Every app you use runs on math. Once you know how to make the computer calculate for you, you can build programs that actually do useful work.
analogy: The computer is like a super-fast calculator that never makes mistakes.
try_it: Calculate how many seconds are in a day: 24 * 60 * 60. Print the answer. Then try seconds in a week.
tips: Parentheses work just like in math class.
Always put your math result inside quotes in io.println().
common_mistakes: Using x instead of * for multiplication.
Dividing by zero — the computer can't do that.
